info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Expense Claims Management API
info.description: The Expense Claims Management API provides functionality for updating the expense claims of employees within an organization. This enables managers and administrators to efficiently manage, amend, and track employee expenses in a streamlined manner. Typical users include finance teams and HR personnel who need to ensure compliance with company policies while facilitating accurate reimbursements. The API allows for integration with banking systems and internal financial platforms to enhance operational efficiency.

put.summary: Update an expense claim for a specific employee.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of an expense claim associated with a specific employee. Make sure to provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully update the expense claim.
